name: no variables, nothing changes
default is used
a variable inside a word
typed default: number
typed default: decimal keeps its text
typed default: true
typed default: empty string is a default
typed default: null is no default and the value is empty
a declaration without a body
a default may use the variables before it
precedence: a vars file beats the default
precedence: set beats a vars file
precedence: set-file beats a vars file
a name in a vars file that the recipe does not declare is ignored
names are letters, digits and underscore, in both cases
a literal dollar brace
two dollars stay as they are
a variable in a file path and the mode
the body of a file is not a template unless it says so
recipe:
vars:
  site: {default: a}
steps:
  - run: [echo, "${site}"]
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/a.conf
      content: "server ${site} ${nginx_var};\n"

name: a template body gets the variables, $${ and $$
recipe:
vars:
  site: {default: a.test}
steps:
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/a.conf
      template: true
      content: "host ${site} $${not_a_var} $$\n"

name: a source file beside the recipe goes in as it is
recipe:
vars:
  site: {default: a}
steps:
  - run: [echo, "${site}"]
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/a.conf
      source: files/a.conf

name: a source file with template: true gets the variables
recipe:
vars:
  site: {default: a}
steps:
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/a.conf
      source: files/a.conf
      template: true
      mode: "0600"

name: the name of a source may be a variable
recipe:
vars:
  site: {default: a.test}
steps:
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/a.conf
      source: files/${site}.conf

name: split: a word of a list becomes several
recipe:
vars:
  pkgs: {default: "nginx git", split: true}
steps:
  - package: [curl, "${pkgs}"]
  - run: [pkg, install, -y, "${pkgs}", "--", "x ${pkgs}"]

name: split: a package value that is the whole variable is the list
a variable that is not split is one word with its spaces
a required variable with an empty value is given
a value of several lines from a file
recipe:
vars:
  block: {required: true}
steps:
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/a.conf
      template: true
      content: "${block}\n"

name: a value is not searched for variables again
a secret goes into a template file only, and marks the request
recipe:
vars:
  pw: {secret: true, required: true}
  user: {default: app}
steps:
  - run: [echo, "${user}"]
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/app.conf
      template: true
      mode: "0600"
      content: "password=${pw}\n"

name: a secret in a source file that is a template
recipe:
vars:
  pw: {secret: true, required: true}
steps:
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/app.conf
      source: files/app.conf.in
      template: true

name: a dir step passes through
a required variable without a value
a required secret says how to give it
a variable that is never used
recipe:
vars:
  site: {default: a}
steps:
  - run: [echo, hi]

name: a reference that is not declared
an undeclared reference in a template says the line
recipe:
steps:
  - file:
      path: /usr/local/etc/a.conf
      template: true
      content: "a\nb ${nope}\n"

name: a malformed reference
an unterminated reference
set names a variable that is not declared
error: --set typo: the recipe declares no such variable

name: set-file names a variable that is not declared
set and set-file together
a secret is refused in set
a secret is refused in a vars file
a secret has no default
recipe:
vars:
  pw: {secret: true, default: x}
steps:
  - run: [echo, hi]

name: a secret is refused in an argument
error: steps[0].run[1]: pw is secret and may be used only in the content of a file step with template: true

name: a secret is refused in a path
a secret is refused in a source name
a secret is refused in a default
a secret in inline content that is not a template is never used
a secret is not split

vars:
  pw: {secret: true, split: true}
steps:
  - run: [echo]

name: required and a default
recipe:
vars:
  x: {required: true, default: a}
steps:
  - run: [echo, "${x}"]

name: a value of several lines with set
a variable name with a digit first
a variable name with a dash
recipe:
vars:
  a-b: {default: a}
steps:
  - run: [echo, hi]

name: an unknown key of a declaration
a default that is a list
an unquoted false in a command
an unquoted false says to quote
an unquoted number in a mode
a source that is not there
error: steps[0].file.source: files/none.conf is not a regular file

name: a source with a path that leaves the directory
error: must be a path below the directory of the recipe

name: source and content

steps:
  - file: {path: /usr/local/etc/a, source: files/a, content: x}
error: give a source or content, not both

name: template without a body
error: template: true needs a source or content

name: an unknown field
two documents
a requirement: check and message
recipe:
requirements:
  - check: [test, -x, /usr/sbin/sshd]
    message: sshd is not installed in the jail
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

requirements.message: sshd is not installed in the jail

name: a requirement takes variables in check and message
recipe:
vars:
  bin: {default: /usr/sbin/sshd}
requirements:
  - check: [test, -x, "${bin}"]
    message: "${bin} is missing, and $${bin} stays"
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

name: a split variable is several words of a check
recipe:
vars:
  tools: {default: "a b", split: true}
requirements:
  - check: [which, "${tools}"]
    message: tools are missing
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

name: a variable used only in a requirement is used
recipe:
vars:
  who: {default: root}
requirements:
  - check: [pw, usershow, "${who}"]
    message: no such user
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

name: a secret in the check of a requirement
recipe:
vars:
  pw: {secret: true}
requirements:
  - check: [test, "${pw}"]
    message: x
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

name: a secret in the message of a requirement
recipe:
vars:
  pw: {secret: true}
requirements:
  - check: [/usr/bin/true]
    message: "the password is ${pw}"
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

name: an undeclared variable in a requirement
recipe:
requirements:
  - check: [/usr/bin/true]
    message: "${nope}"
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

name: a requirement has only check and message
recipe:
requirements:
  - check: [/usr/bin/true]
    message: x
    when: always
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]

name: requirements are a list
a requirement is a map
error: requirements[0]: a requirement is a map

name: the check of a requirement is a list of words
recipe:
requirements:
  - check: true
    message: x
steps:
  - run: [echo, hello]
